'''Sibs Monchan''' was a [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] entrepreneur who lived during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Monchan made a living designing [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] interfaces, helping his firm, [[Monchantics]], to earn him millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. At some point, Monchan accompanied the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' on a cruise from [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]] to [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], and on one occasion during the voyage, he dined in the company of the [[Bivall/Legends|Bivall]] real estate mangnate [[Usk Haffa]], the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] liquor distributor [[Dix Tarfait]], the [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonians]] [[Fume Pachoola|Fume]] and [[Pelf Pachoola]], and the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. The following day, Ohnaka arranged for the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to be struck by an explosion, in an effort by him to convince several of the passengers to follow him into an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], so that he could kidnap them. However, Monchan refused to board the pod and claimed that he believed that it was safer to remain aboard the ship.
